channel.title: Fireside Notes on r1skers' Blog
channel.description: Recent content in Fireside Notes on r1skers' Blog

item.title: [Fireside Notes] Embedded C Chronicles: Traps, Idioms, and Best Practices
item.description: A living collection of engineering wisdom and lessons learned from STM32 development. Covering topics from timer overflows to memory management.

item.title: [Fireside Notes] The First Step into Embedded Systems: Blinking LED & Speaking UART
item.description: A journey from toggling GPIOs to mastering serial communication on STM32. Understanding the heartbeat and the voice of a microcontroller.

item.title: [Fireside Notes] Quantum Mechanics Part 1: From Schrödinger to Wave Functions
item.description: Exploring the probabilistic nature of the quantum world. A derivation of the Schrödinger equation and visualization of wave functions using Python (Matplotlib).

item.title: [Fireside Notes] Convolution and Sampling in Fourier and Laplace
item.description: Unveiling the mathematical symmetry between Time and Frequency domains. A deep dive into why multiplication in one domain equals convolution in the other, and the mystery of spectrum replication.
